<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { HeroContent } from "./hero-split.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { Quote } from "./testimonial-grid.types";
  import type { OfferCard } from "./store-hero.types";
  import type { Plan } from "./pricing-card.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type HeroSplitProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    actions: LinkActions;
    content: HeroContent;
    extra?: "stats" | "avatars" | "minis" | "quote" | "none";
    media?: "picture" | "card" | "grid" | "plans";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import HeroSplitExtras from "../components/hero-split-extras.svelte";
  import HeroSplitMedia from "../components/hero-split-media.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    level = 1,
    actions,
    content,
    extra = "stats",
    media = "picture",
    mediaSide = "end",

    secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
    secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
  />
  {#snippet aside()}
    <HeroSplitMedia content={content} alt={title} media={media} />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
